name: Drillmaster's gold whistle
description: Sergeant Major Krane's gold-plated parade whistle on a braided lanyard, engraved with forty years of graduating classes. Only found on him.

name: Furnace King's gilded wrench
description: The old night foreman's wrench, plated with gold Iron Matvei melted down in the boiler house. He holds court with it like a sceptre. Only found on him.

name: Tollkeeper's cash brick
description: A vacuum-sealed brick of hundred-dollar notes out of Varga's strongbox: a year of tolls from everyone who crossed the customs yard. Only found on him.

name: Snow leopard pelt
description: The rarest thing Old Leshy ever poached, cured over pine smoke and rolled tight. A buyer in the city would pay more for it than for the whole forest. Only found on him.

name: Undertow black pearl
description: A black pearl the size of a cherry, set in a heavy gold ring. Captain Reyes takes it off only to count the cargo. Only found on her.

name: Director's black-box drive
description: Director Varn's sealed security archive: every camera, door log and experiment record from the day Lab Zero went dark. Someone will pay anything to see it, or to make sure nobody does. Only found on her.
